summary: Initializes a rotation/quaternion structure from a source a2: copies the four input dwords into this[0..3], duplicates a2[1] and a2[2] into this[4] and this[5], zeroes this[6] and the 0x2C-byte block from this+7 via memset, sets the sentinel this[18] to -1, zeroes the trailing five dwords this[19..23], and returns 0.

operations.description: Copy the four input dwords from a2 into this[0], this[1], this[2], this[3] (components at offsets 0x0, 0x4, 0x8, 0xC).
Duplicate source components: this[4] = a2[1] and this[5] = a2[2] (offsets 0x10 and 0x14).
Zero the 0x2C-byte block beginning at this+7 (memset), clearing the intermediate fields.
Set this[18] (offset 0x48) to -1, a sentinel value.
Zero the trailing fields this[19] through this[23] (offsets 0x4C, 0x50, 0x54, 0x58, 0x5C).
Invoked by SpatialTreeInsertion (004485D0) and TriangleMeshAdjacencyBuilder (004493A0) during spatial-tree and mesh-adjacency construction.
